messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks, so I can’t give you the exact minute‑by‑minute time right now.  
But here’s how you can figure it out:

| Time zone | UTC offset (DST) | When DST is in effect |
|-----------|------------------|-----------------------|
| Eastern Time (New York) | UTC‑4 | March – November (2026) |

So if you know the current Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), simply subtract 4 hours to get the local time in New York City. For example, if it’s **15:00 UTC**, it would be **11:00 EDT** in New York.

If you’d like a quick check, most smartphones, computers, and smart assistants (Alexa, Siri, Google Assistant) will display the current time for any city when you ask.
